audience: sales teams who manage deals and contacts in Pipedrive

useCases.title: Review open deals by pipeline stage
useCases.text: The AI lists deals filtered by pipeline, stage, owner or status, and sums up which deals sit in each stage.

useCases.title: Get the full picture of a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches for a company, then reads its contacts, deals and notes in one summary.

useCases.title: Find unfinished activities and due dates
useCases.text: The AI lists activities filtered by owner, deal, person, or done status, and shows what is still open and when it is due.

useCases.title: Add a new deal or contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a person with email and phone, or a deal with a title linked to a person, organization, pipeline and stage.

useCases.title: Log a note or schedule an activity
useCases.text: The AI adds a note to a deal, person, organization or lead, or creates a task or event with type, date and time.

useCases.title: Search across deals, people and more
useCases.text: The AI searches one term over deals, persons, organizations, products, leads and files, and shows the matches.
